title: DevForgeAI worker result
description: The receipt: the single JSON object a phase worker returns as its final message on either provider. It carries no file bodies and no hashes. A producer has already written its files inside the candidate root; a judge has written only its findings under .devforgeai/work/<run>/evidence/<agent>/, which is outside every candidate root, gitignored and never promoted. The sequencer validates this object at the identity-bearing SubagentStop event, diffs the candidate root against the input checkpoint to derive what actually changed, runs the transition oracle inside the root, checkpoints, and advances, retries, or rewinds.

run.description: The active run id. Story runs use the story id; document runs use '<skill>-<arg>'. Must equal run.yaml#run.

skill.description: The active skill, or one of its variants. 'dev-tdd' resolves to 'dev'.

agent.description: The canonical worker name, or a registered alias. Must resolve to the same canonical name as the stop event's agent_type; the model-supplied value is never identity.

status.description: Closed worker status vocabulary. gate_policy values are never returned here.

reason_code.description: Required when status is could_not_run; rejected with any other status.

candidate.description: Which candidate root the worker worked in, and which checkpoint it started from. Required on every status, because a judge that read a checkpoint must name the one it read.

id.description: The candidate id, which is the run id. Must equal run.yaml#run.

input_checkpoint.description: The checkpoint this phase started from: 'base', or the name of the phase whose checkpoint it read. Must equal run.yaml#candidate.checkpoint at dispatch.

claimed_paths.description: Every path the worker believes it created, edited or deleted inside the candidate root, root-relative. Empty on any status other than pass, and empty from a judge, whose only write path is .devforgeai/work/<run>/evidence/<agent>/ and lies outside every candidate root. The sequencer derives the truth from the checkpoint diff and refuses the receipt when the derived change set is not a subset of this list (UNCLAIMED_CHANGE). That subset check runs only on status pass: a producer that edited and then failed claims nothing by rule and has changed something in fact, so on a non-pass status the diff is recorded as changed_unchecked and no fence, policy or oracle check runs over it.

evidence_refs.description: Paths to evidence the sequencer should read: a report inside the candidate root, or an oracle output the sequencer already wrote under .devforgeai/work/<run>/. A report-producing phase names its report here, and the report's own frontmatter carries the verdict that selects the handoff row. A judge names the findings files it wrote under .devforgeai/work/<run>/evidence/<agent>/. Never a file body.

note.description: At most three lines of plain summary. Rendered into <phase>-report.md.

issues.description: One-line findings. Not a repair instruction and not a status.

next.description: A rewind request naming an earlier phase of the same skill. Legal only with status fail, only from a phase that declares rewind_to, and only when it equals that phase's rewind_to. The sequencer rewinds the candidate root to the checkpoint the named phase started from - its predecessor's, or base when it is the first phase - and re-enters it, because the named phase's own output is what is being redone.

path.description: A POSIX path relative to the candidate root, or to the project root for an evidence path under .devforgeai/work/<run>/. Must resolve inside the root it is relative to.
